analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($57.00) vs SMA5/20/50 ($56.89/$56.22/$53.99) — short-term bullish, mid-term bullish bias.
· 8.64% above SMA100/200 ($52.22/$52.47) — mid-to-long-term trend strength is good.
· 52-week position (94.0%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (59.6->63.0) + staying neutral + weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1043->-0.0322) + improving diagnosis + weak convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $56.22) + normal band width of 4.06%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($55.45) + based on Pivot S1 ($55.43).
· Swing resistance ($57.60) + matches 52-week high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation) + no trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.94x) + moderate reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (consolidation within uptrend) + consider buying on breakout above 52-week high.
